about_short_description.short_description: ShipBlu is a platform that redefines the e-commerce shipping and fulfillment experience providing 24-hour delivery with live tracking.

product.name: Instant Payout
product.description: A service that delivers cash collections to merchants on the same day to support business growth and cash flow needs.

product.name: Valu Installments via myBlu App
product.description: A payment option allowing customers to pay for purchases in installments up to 60 months through the myBlu app.

product.name: ShipBlu Verify
product.description: A delivery verification system that confirms each delivery attempt to reduce human intervention and enhance legitimacy.

product.name: ShipBlu Secure
product.description: A security feature that sends a unique QR code to customers on delivery day to ensure secure and verified shipment receipt.

product.name: Real-Time Tracking System
product.description: A system providing instant tracking updates to merchants and customers about shipment status in real time.

product.name: Automated Billing and Invoicing
product.description: An automated system that generates invoices and statements accessible via a merchant dashboard to streamline financial management.
